goal: Build the desktop wallpaper, invisible menu bar, Dock, Control Center, and Spotlight overlay.
summary: Core Shell phase complete. Delivered Desktop, MenuBar, Dock, ControlCenter, and Spotlight components with passing tests and clean lint/build. All components follow the Liquid Glass styling conventions and are ready for window-manager integration.
stepSummaries:
1. Desktop component renders a wallpaper and acts as the drop target/background for windows. [verified]
  2. MenuBar component renders system menus and updates the left-side app label based on the active app. [verified]
  3. Dock component displays curated app icons and emits an open-app event on click. [verified]
  4. Control Center component opens/closes from the menu-bar tray and shows approximate toggles (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, brightness, volume, etc.). [verified]
  5. Spotlight component toggles on Cmd+Space or Ctrl+Space, filters apps/mock files, and launches the selected app on Enter. [verified]
